# Cycle99 Leo art provenance

`baseline.json` and `SHA256.json` were captured before any Leo99 variant wiring. They preserve all24 authored dialogue definitions,48 entry observations (day600/night1290),72 outcome observations, effects/resource states and120 controlled saves. The controlled saves are isolated reproductions derived from the actual98 unpaid357 state; they are not additional players or natural encounters. Choice outcomes are selected deterministically solely for this regression.

The first capture's six natural saves are three actual98 unpaid-before-render and three entry-after-render saves. The separate immutable `natural-supplement.json` / `supplement-SHA256.json` adds the corresponding three natural entry receipts and three natural paid receipts. No first capture file or hash was overwritten. Each provenance entry points to its unchanged98 source and SHA256.

Full saved reader and view-only checks preserve their exact historical words, roles, pictures, receipt and rewards. The deliberate text-only variants remove reading/view/authoredView from copies, never from fixture originals. Their text/chips/state and old revision's scene selection must survive; these tests do not claim reconstruction of deleted reader formatting. Existing11 camp variants retain their exact pre99 legacy mapping, while13 formerly untimed road events retain null legacy. A future first payment on an old unpaid save receives qa99, leaving its historical entry unchanged.

No game is started. No actual browser input, crop, or audio is exercised by these isolated engine/pure-renderer tests.

Final current definition has exactly one permitted gameplay delta: talk_leo_05 needsDog:true. All other definition fields, text/functions, effects and notes remain identical to this immutable baseline. The regression also checks controlled dog-false copies of old05 unpaid and paid receipts remain loadable/readable and cannot repay. These copies are counterfactual compatibility probes, not naturally observed no-dog receipts.

Canonical chip colors already differed in the pre99 capture: some first result colors were empty strings, while saved receipt validation canonicalized them to item. Cycle99 does not alter that engine. Fresh result chips still match this baseline exactly; replay compares the unchanged canonical receipt. See cycle99/survival/existing-chip-canonicalization.json for both original representations and unchanged04h SHA.
